headline: Trevecca beat AUM to join them on top
dek: Trevecca won at AUM without conceding and now sit level with them at the head of the table. It was their eleventh win in fourteen matches this season, and the only side to have beaten them is Lee, who won at Trevecca in September.
displaced_by: Trevecca beat AUM and drew level on points, and the standing dek's AUM figures no longer hold

wire.line: Trevecca won at AUM and now share top spot; Hunter Walker has kept seven clean sheets behind them.
